patterns.note: The hero features a large, fixed-position, uppercase text overlay ("MANDA") that remains static while a full-bleed, glitch-effect video or image sequence plays and transitions dramatically behind it as the user scrolls.
Content sections below the hero frequently use a split-screen layout with large, impactful imagery on one side and descriptive text on the other, often alternating sides down the page.

A high-contrast palette of deep dark backgrounds (black/charcoal) paired with stark white typography and vibrant, often neon-like, accent colors (pinks, oranges, blues, reds) used in imagery and occasional graphic elements.
Headings are consistently large, bold, and set in an all-caps sans-serif typeface, creating a strong, impactful visual hierarchy against smaller, more readable body text.
A 'Related Work' section concludes pages, presenting a grid of three-column image cards with project titles and categories, maintaining the site's energetic visual style.

technique_notes: The initial hero section uses a full-viewport video or image sequence as a background, which is dynamically replaced or animated with a glitch/chromatic aberration effect as the user scrolls, while a large, fixed-position text element remains overlaid on top, likely orchestrated with GSAP.

Content sections throughout the site are revealed with subtle scroll-triggered animations, typically fading in or sliding up from the bottom as they enter the viewport, often with a slight delay for text elements, indicating GSAP ScrollTrigger usage.
Imagery across the site often incorporates digital distortion, color shifts, or motion blur effects, contributing to a dynamic and energetic visual style that feels almost like digital art.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, uppercase headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual impact, contrasted with smaller, highly legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for all elements, including images and content blocks, contributing to a modern, crisp aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within content blocks, ensuring readability and visual breathing room.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly dynamic and visually aggressive hero section, where a large, fixed-position text overlay interacts with a constantly changing, glitch-effect video background that transitions dramatically on scroll. This creates an immediate, high-energy, and memorable brand impression that is far from a generic template.
